body:
Name: Amber26Theta
Reason: "Ban Evasion"(false)
I have been banned from Avicus because of this reason:
"You have been banned by MLGPorky for Ban Evasion (Jo10843)"
Jo10843 is my friend's account, not my own. We were on the same network when we were both banned. Since this, we have both made appeals and I believe that you think Jo10843 is an alt account. I have no alternative accounts, and neither does Jo10843. Other than this: I have evidence that he is not an alternative account. I recently posted my own ban appeal two days ago, and got unbanned quickly (thanks!). After this, I told Jo10843 over Skype to make an appeal himself. Today, he made one and we were both banned.

Sincerely,

Amber
